Ambush in the Hollowmarket — Black sashes converge, hatchets and a snarling enforcer between you and the chapel road.
Approach to the Hollow Bell Ruins — A collapsed bridge and a slope of rubble bar the way down into the ruined chapel grounds, where the humming grows loud enough to feel in your teeth.
The Hollow Bell Chapel — Inside the ruined chapel a cracked bell hangs over a ritual circle scrawled in soot and old blood. Ledgers of debt owed between brothers line the wall
The Ledger of Grudges — A sealed case holds the true accounting of what Orune believes he is owed — and perhaps a way to settle the debt on your own terms.
Face to Face with the Grudge-Priest — The grudge-priest stands before the cracked bell, robes stitched with unpaid debts. She smiles like someone who has already won the argument.
The Grudge-Priest's Guard — The priest laughs and calls her guard from the shadows between the pews — steel, bone, and a captain who has clearly done this before.
